verdict.rationale: Bruno has no programmatic management API; the OpenAPI probe found nothing. It does offer two non-UI routes. Collections are plain-text Bru files on the filesystem that agents and IDEs can create and edit directly, and the official bru CLI runs collections, generates reports, and overrides environment variables. Missing for 10: a documented API or CLI covering all UI operations (e.g., the AI features, Git UI actions, auth configuration, apps, mocks), an explicit UI/API parity statement, and independent confirmation that file edits plus the CLI fully substitute for the UI.
